name: she-azure-sql-api
description: SHE System - REST API for Microsoft Azure SQL Database and SQLite Migration Utility

scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (fs.existsSync('dist') && !fs.existsSync('build')) fs.cpSync('dist', 'build', { recursive: true }); else if (fs.existsSync('build') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.cpSync('build', 'dist', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build complete'); })"
